issue.title: Fix recording upload failing on expo-file-system getInfoAsync deprecation
issue.body:
## Summary

After Record landed, auto-upload fails because `recordingSync.ts` imports `getInfoAsync` from `expo-file-system` (non-legacy). Expo treats that as an error and the upload orchestrator retries then fails.

`audioStorage.ts` already uses `expo-file-system/legacy`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `recordingSync` uses `expo-file-system/legacy` (same as audio storage)
- [ ] Upload path no longer fails with the getInfoAsync deprecation message
- [ ] Unit tests still pass

## Repro

1. Record takes on device
2. Upload orchestrator starts
3. Logs show Recording upload failed with getInfoAsync deprecation message
